title: Contact
subtitle: Have questions or need help? Get in touch with us.

email.title: Email Us
email.description: Contact us via email for all inquiries. We typically respond within 24 hours.

topics.title: What can you contact us about?

addDrug.question: How do I add a new medication to my kit?
addDrug.answer: Click "Add Medication" in the sidebar, fill out the form with the name, form, and expiration date, then save.

export.question: Can I export my medication list?
export.answer: Yes! On the "Medications" page, you'll find an "Export PDF" button that allows you to download your complete medication list in PDF format.

notifications.question: How do expiration notifications work?
notifications.answer: Medications expire on the last day of the month shown on the package. Daily at 9:00 AM, the system checks which medications expire in the current month and sends a consolidated email with their list. Each medication notification is sent only once.

recommend.question: Can I recommend this app to friends?
recommend.answer: Absolutely! We'd be grateful for any recommendations. You can also share your feedback on social media or leave a review!

about.title: About the App
about.description: First Aid Kit is an application for managing your home first aid kit. It allows you to track medications, their expiration dates, and receive notifications about upcoming expiry dates.
